message.content: im practicing using the site but feel like i have a lot of variance and going off beat often. “Variant is high” is such an engineer way to describe flamming your hi-hat.  You’re probably right though. When drumming feels inconsistent, it’s usually one of three things:  ### 1. Your internal clock is wobbling  Your brain thinks it’s steady. It is not. Humans are optimistic metronomes.  If you’re not practicing with a click, start. If you are, try this instead of just playing along:  * Put the metronome on **2 and 4 only** * Or even nastier: set it to **half-time** * Or ultra evil: one click every bar  If you can’t sit inside that without rushing fills, your timing variance is real.  ---  ### 2. You’re tensing up  Tension = micro timing errors.  Check:  * Are your shoulders creeping up? * Is your grip tight? * Is your kick leg stomping instead of rebounding?  Drumming is rebound physics. If you’re muscling it, your dynamics and timing both scatter.  ---  ### 3. You’re playing above your clean tempo  Classic mistake. You can *almost* play it at 120 bpm. So you practice at 118. Bad move.  Drop it 15–20 bpm below where you feel “good.” Make it boringly clean. Then inch up 2–3 bpm at a time.  Brutal patience beats fake progress.  ---  ### A practical drill (no fluff)  * Pick one groove. * 5 minutes straight. * No fills. * Record it. * Listen back.  You will hear the drift. It’s humbling. Necessary.  ---  Also, if you ran a marathon last year, your endurance is not the problem. Your nervous system just hasn’t automated the pattern yet. Drumming is high-resolution motor control, not cardio.  If you want to get nerdy about it:  * Think of each limb as an independent thread. * Right now they’re blocking each other. * Goal is async execution without jitter.  Clean subdivision in your head fixes half of this. Count 16ths out loud. If you can’t say it, you can’t play it.  This phase is normal. It feels messy before it locks in. That annoying instability is literally your brain rewiring.  Now go slow down and suffer productively.

1→# Drum Practice
     2→
     3→A web-based drumming practice app for rhythm training. Features a visual beat grid/sequencer, synthesized drum sounds, a library of common patterns and rudiments, and practice tools like tempo ramping and live tap-along mode.
     4→
     5→**No audio files needed** — all drum sounds are generated in real-time using the Web Audio API.
     6→
     7→## Features
     8→
     9→- **Pattern Library** — 12 built-in patterns across rock, funk, latin, world, and rudiment categories
    10→- **Visual Beat Grid** — Interactive sequencer with click-to-toggle steps, color-coded by instrument
    11→- **Synthesized Drums** — Kick, snare, hi-hat (open/closed), 3 toms, crash, and ride cymbals
    12→- **Precise Timing** — Lookahead scheduler using the Web Audio clock for rock-solid rhythm
    13→- **BPM Control** — Slider, +/- buttons, and tap tempo (40–240 BPM)
    14→- **Swing** — Adjustable swing feel (0–100%)
    15→- **Practice Modes** — Loop and Tempo Ramp (gradually increase speed over N bars)
    16→- **Live Practice** — Tap along to patterns and get real-time timing accuracy feedback
    17→- **Per-Instrument Volume** — Individual volume and mute controls for each track
    18→- **Keyboard Shortcuts** — Space (play/pause), Escape (stop), arrow keys (BPM)
    19→- **Dark Theme** — Easy on the eyes during practice sessions
    20→- **Mobile Responsive** — Horizontally scrollable grid, stacked controls on small screens
    21→
    22→## Getting Started
    23→
    24→```bash
    25→npm install
    26→npm run dev
    27→```
    28→
    29→Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.
    30→
    31→## Tech Stack
    32→
    33→- [Next.js 15](https://nextjs.org) (App Router, TypeScript)
    34→- [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com)
    35→- [Zustand](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs) (state management)
    36→- [Web Audio API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Audio_API) (sound synthesis + scheduling)
    37→
    38→## Architecture
    39→
    40→### Audio Engine (`src/lib/audio/`)
    41→
    42→- **AudioEngine.ts** — Singleton managing `AudioContext` → `DynamicsCompressor` → `GainNode` → `destination`. Lazy-initialized on first user gesture (browser autoplay policy). Pre-generates a shared white noise buffer for snare/hi-hat/cymbal synthesis.
    43→- **DrumSynth.ts** — Pure functions that create short-lived Web Audio nodes for each drum sound:
    44→  - Kick: triangle + sine oscillators with pitch envelope
    45→  - Snare: filtered white noise + triangle oscillator body
    46→  - Hi-hat: 6 square-wave oscillators at metallic frequency ratios, bandpass/highpass filtered
    47→  - Toms: sine oscillator with pitch sweep (3 variants)
    48→  - Crash/Ride: filtered white noise with long/medium decay
    49→- **Scheduler.ts** — Lookahead scheduler (25ms `setTimeout` interval, 100ms schedule-ahead window). Schedules notes against the precise Web Audio clock. Supports swing timing and bar counting.
    50→
    51→### Pattern Data (`src/lib/patterns/`)
    52→
    53→Each pattern defines tracks (instruments) with step arrays. Supports 4/4, 3/4, and 6/8 time signatures with 8th note, 16th note, and triplet subdivisions.
    54→
    55→| Pattern | Category | Time Sig | Subdivision | Default BPM |
    56→|---|---|---|---|---|
    57→| Basic Rock Beat | Rock | 4/4 | 8th | 100 |
    58→| Rock Beat (16ths) | Rock | 4/4 | 16th | 90 |
    59→| Four on the Floor | Rock | 4/4 | 8th | 120 |
    60→| Basic Shuffle | Rock | 4/4 | Triplet | 100 |
    61→| Basic Funk | Funk | 4/4 | 16th | 95 |
    62→| Syncopated Funk | Funk | 4/4 | 16th | 90 |
    63→| Bossa Nova | Latin | 4/4 | 16th | 130 |
    64→| 6/8 Feel | World | 6/8 | 8th | 80 |
    65→| Afro 6/8 | World | 6/8 | 8th | 90 |
    66→| Single Paradiddle | Rudiment | 4/4 | 16th | 80 |
    67→| Single Stroke Roll | Rudiment | 4/4 | 16th | 80 |
    68→| Double Stroke Roll | Rudiment | 4/4 | 16th | 70 |
    69→
    70→### State Management (`src/lib/store/`)
    71→
    72→Uses Zustand stores with no providers needed:
    73→
    74→- **useTransportStore** — Play/pause/stop state, BPM, current step, swing
    75→- **usePatternStore** — Current pattern, step toggling, track volume/mute
    76→- **usePracticeStore** — Practice mode (loop/tempo-ramp), session stats
    77→- **useSettingsStore** — Master volume, persisted to localStorage
    78→- **useLivePracticeStore** — Live tap-along mode state, accuracy tracking

1→# Changelog

     3→All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

     5→## [0.6.0] - 2026-02-27
     6→
     7→### Added
     8→- **Floating Grade Toast** — animated label ("Perfect!", "Great +12ms", etc.) floats up and fades after each tap during live practice
     9→- **Timing Deviation Indicator** — horizontal bar showing how early/late each tap is, with color-coded dot (green center → orange edges, ±100ms scale)
    10→- **Streak Combo Display** — combo counter appears at 3+ streak with escalating visual tiers:
    11→  - 3–9: green glow ("Streak")
    12→  - 10–19: yellow pulse ("On Fire")
    13→  - 20+: orange pulsing glow ("Unstoppable")
    14→  - "Streak Lost" flash on break
    15→- **Bar History Strip** — rolling strip of per-bar accuracy blocks below the beat grid, showing last 12 bars color-coded by accuracy
    16→- **Timing Distribution Bar** — stacked colored bar showing percentage breakdown of perfect/great/good/off/miss grades (shown in results modal and progress page)
    17→- **Session Comparison** — results modal now shows accuracy delta vs previous session ("↑12% from last session" or "↓5%")
    18→- **Bar-by-Bar Trend** — mini bar chart in results modal showing accuracy progression across bars within a session
    19→- **Avg Accuracy** tile added to progress dashboard overall stats row
    20→- **Trend Arrows** in progress page per-pattern session list showing accuracy change between sessions

    22→### Changed
    23→- Live practice store tracks `lastTapOffset`, `streakBroken`, and per-bar hit/total counters
    24→- `SessionStats` now includes `barHistory` for post-session analysis
    25→- Results modal redesigned with timing distribution bar, previous session comparison, and bar trend chart
    26→- Progress page pattern details now show timing breakdown bars per session
    27→- Overall stats row expanded from 4 to 5 tiles (added avg accuracy)

    29→## [0.5.0] - 2026-02-19
    30→
    31→### Added
    32→- **Practice History & Stats Tracking** — all practice sessions persisted to localStorage
    33→  - Every live session records: pattern, accuracy, BPM, duration, timing stats

### 1.1 How Timing Variance is Measured

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/live-practice/TapMatcher.ts`

The timing variance is calculated using **precise Web Audio API timestamps**:

```typescript
// Timing thresholds define variance bands (in seconds)
TIMING_THRESHOLDS = {
  PERFECT: 0.015,    // ≤15ms
  GREAT: 0.030,      // ≤30ms
  GOOD: 0.050,       // ≤50ms
  MAX_WINDOW: 0.100,  // ≤100ms (miss threshold)
}

// When a user taps, the matcher finds the closest expected beat
processTap(tapTime, instrumentId) {
  // Calculate absolute offset from expected beat time
  const absOffset = Math.abs(tapTime - beat.time);
  
  // Assign grade based on offset
  if (absOffset ≤ 0.015) grade = 'perfect'
  else if (absOffset ≤ 0.030) grade = 'great'
  else if (absOffset ≤ 0.050) grade = 'good'
  else grade = 'early' or 'late' (depending on sign)
}
```

**Key Metrics Tracked:**
- `offset`: Signed timing difference (positive = late, negative = early) in seconds
- `grade`: Categorical grade (perfect/great/good/early/late/miss)
- `averageOffset`: Running average of all tap offsets (accumulated in store)

## 5. SPACED REPETITION (SM-2 Algorithm)

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/spaced-repetition/sm2.ts`

### Accuracy-to-Quality Mapping:
```
≥95% → Quality 5 (perfect)
85–94% → Quality 4 (good)
70–84% → Quality 3 (ok)
50–69% → Quality 2 (hard)
30–49% → Quality 1 (very hard)
<30% → Quality 0 (fail)
```

### Interval Logic:
- **Quality ≥3 (success)**: Advance interval
  - 1st success → 1 day
  - 2nd success → 6 days
  - 3rd+ success → interval × ease factor (capped 365 days)
- **Quality <3 (failure)**: Reset to 1 day

### Ease Factor Adjustment:
```
easeFactor += 0.1 − (5 − quality) × (0.08 + (5 − quality) × 0.02)
Min: 1.3, Max: 2.5+
```

### Mastery Levels:
```
New (0 reps) → Learning (1–2 reps) → Familiar (3–5 reps) → Mastered (6+ reps)
```

## 5. SPACED REPETITION (SM-2 Algorithm)

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/spaced-repetition/sm2.ts`

### Accuracy-to-Quality Mapping:
```
≥95% → Quality 5 (perfect)
85–94% → Quality 4 (good)
70–84% → Quality 3 (ok)
50–69% → Quality 2 (hard)
30–49% → Quality 1 (very hard)
<30% → Quality 0 (fail)
```

### Interval Logic:
- **Quality ≥3 (success)**: Advance interval
  - 1st success → 1 day
  - 2nd success → 6 days
  - 3rd+ success → interval × ease factor (capped 365 days)
- **Quality <3 (failure)**: Reset to 1 day

### Ease Factor Adjustment:
```
easeFactor += 0.1 − (5 − quality) × (0.08 + (5 − quality) × 0.02)
Min: 1.3, Max: 2.5+
```

### Mastery Levels:
```
New (0 reps) → Learning (1–2 reps) → Familiar (3–5 reps) → Mastered (6+ reps)
```

## 10. WORKFLOW EXAMPLE

**User practicing "Basic Rock Beat" in Live Mode:**

1. **Start**: Press play → `startSession()` resets stats, starts TapMatcher
2. **Tap D key**: 
   - `useLiveKeyboardHandler` triggers `playInstrument(kick)`
   - `TapMatcher.processTap()` compares tap time to expected beat
   - Calculates `offset` (e.g., −12ms, meaning 12ms early)
   - Assigns `grade: 'great'` (−12ms is within 30ms threshold)
3. **Feedback**:
   - `GradeToast` shows "Great −12ms" (600ms animation)
   - `TimingIndicator` dot moves left (early side)
   - `LiveStatsPanel` updates: accuracy, streak, last tap color
4. **Per-bar**: Every 16 steps, `recordBarEnd()` calculates bar accuracy %
5. **Stop**: Final sweep for misses, results modal shows session summary
6. **Save**: `addSession()` persists to localStorage, `updateCard()` runs SM-2 algorithm

## Conclusion

The drum practice app provides **comprehensive, multi-layered feedback on timing variance** without using the phrase "variant is high." Instead, it shows:
- **Real-time animated grades** (Perfect/Great/Good/Early/Late)
- **Visual early/late indicator** (slider bar)
- **Per-bar and overall accuracy metrics**
- **Timing distribution breakdown** (pie-chart style bars)
- **Historical tracking** with trend analysis

Combined with **flexible practice modes** (Loop, Tempo Ramp, Full Kit, Single Track), **precise BPM control**, and **spaced repetition analytics**, users get a complete practice experience with actionable feedback at every level of detail.

Great advice. The app currently shows timing grades (Perfect/Great/Good/Early/Late) with millisecond offsets and a visual early/late indicator — functional but clinical. No "variance is high" message exists, but the raw numbers tell the same story.

A few ideas from that advice that the app *doesn't* support yet:

1. **Sparse metronome modes** — clicks on 2&4 only, half-time, or one click per bar. Right now it's a steady click. Those reduced-click modes are exactly the kind of thing that exposes wobbly internal timing.

2. **Focused drill mode** — "one groove, 5 minutes, no fills, record it." The app has loop mode but no timed drill with forced simplicity.

3. **Friendlier feedback language** — instead of "+23ms (late)" the results could say something more like "You're rushing fills" or "Drifting late on beat 3" based on patterns in the timing data.

4. **Tempo floor finder** — auto-suggest a "clean tempo" by detecting where accuracy drops off, so you know where to actually practice instead of guessing.

Want me to build any of these into the app?

## Comprehensive Exploration Report: Drum Practice App UI Components and Feedback System

Based on my thorough examination of the codebase, here's everything you need to understand about the UI components and feedback system:

---

### 1. **LiveResultsModal.tsx** 
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/live/LiveResultsModal.tsx`

**Props:**
```typescript
interface LiveResultsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
}
```

**Data Structure & Display:**
- Takes `stats` from `useLivePracticeStore` (SessionStats)
- Compares against previous session using `getLastLiveSessionForPattern(patternId)`
- Shows **overall grade** based on accuracy thresholds:
  - 90%+ → "Excellent" (green)
  - 75%+ → "Great" (lime)
  - 60%+ → "Good" (yellow)
  - 40%+ → "Keep Practicing" (orange)
  - <40% → "Try Slower" (red)

**Content Displayed:**
1. Large accuracy % with hits/total count
2. Delta comparison from previous session (color-coded green/red/gray)
3. `TimingBreakdownBar` component showing timing distribution
4. 2-column grid: Best Streak & Avg Timing
5. 5-column grade breakdown: Perfect/Great/Good/Off/Miss counts
6. Bar-by-bar accuracy trend (last 16 bars, colored 80%+ green down to red)
7. Next review date from spaced-rep card
8. "Try Again" and "Back to Patterns" buttons

---

### 2. **LiveStatsPanel.tsx**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/live/LiveStatsPanel.tsx`

**Display Pattern:**
Real-time stats shown during active session (2x2 grid):
- **Accuracy %** (from total hits / total expected)
- **Streak** with best streak in parentheses
- **Avg Timing** (offset in ms, labeled as early/on beat/late)
- **Last Tap Grade** (the most recent grade from `lastTapGrade`)

**Below main grid:**
Grade breakdown line: "X perfect, X great, X good, X off, X miss"

**Visibility:** Hidden when not active and no expected beats recorded

---

### 3. **PracticeModeSelector.tsx**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/practice/PracticeModeSelector.tsx`

**Modes Available:**
```typescript
[
  { id: 'loop', label: 'Loop', description: 'Repeat pattern continuously' },
  { id: 'tempo-ramp', label: 'Tempo Ramp', description: 'Gradually increase speed' }
]
```

**Component Details:**
- Uses `usePracticeStore` (NOT live practice)
- Simple button group toggling between modes
- On tempo-ramp selection, shows `TempoRampConfig` component
- Config allows: startBpm, endBpm, incrementBpm, barsPerIncrement

---

### 4. **Live Practice Page** (`src/app/live/page.tsx`)
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/live/page.tsx`

**Component Hierarchy & Layout:**
```
LivePracticePage
├── Header
└── main (max-w-5xl)
    ├── Pattern info + mode selector
    ├── BeatGrid (with accuracy overlay)
    ├── BarHistoryStrip
    ├── TimingIndicator + StreakDisplay
    └── 3-column grid (md:grid-cols-3)
        ├── Transport + BPM
        ├── TapPadPanel
        └── LiveStatsPanel
    ├── Help text (key mappings)
    └── LiveResultsModal

LiveResultsModal (overlay, z-50)
```

**Key Functionality:**
- **Session Management:** `startSession()` on play, `endSession()` on stop
- **TapMatcher:** Initialized as ref, tracks expected beats and recorded taps
- **Sweep Interval:** Every 50ms checks for missed expected beats
- **History Persistence:** Sessions saved via `addHistorySession()` when duration > 5s
- **Spaced Repetition:** Updates card on completion via `updateCard()`

**Live Mode Toggle:** Shows when `isActive === true` with pulsing red dot

---

### 5. **Progress Page** (`src/app/progress/page.tsx`)
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/progress/page.tsx`

**Component Composition:**
```
ProgressPage
└── main (max-w-5xl)
    ├── Title + description
    └── space-y-6
        ├── OverallStatsRow (5 tiles: time, sessions, patterns, streak, avg accuracy)
        ├── DueForReviewSection
        ├── PracticeCalendar (heat map of practice days)
        └── PatternProgressList (expandable pattern details)
```

**PatternProgressList Details:**
- Groups sessions by patternId
- Shows mastery level badge ("New/Learning/Familiar/Mastered")
- Each pattern expandable to show:
  - Date, Mode, BPM, Accuracy, Trend columns
  - `TimingBreakdownBar` for each session's stats

---

### 6. **usePracticeHistoryStore**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/usePracticeHistoryStore.ts`

**PracticeSession Interface:**
```typescript
interface PracticeSession {
  id: string;                    // crypto.randomUUID()
  patternId: string;
  patternName: string;
  mode: 'loop' | 'tempo-ramp' | 'live';
  startedAt: number;             // timestamp
  endedAt: number;               // timestamp
  durationMs: number;
  bpm: number;
  bpmStart?: number;             // for tempo-ramp
  bpmEnd?: number;               // for tempo-ramp
  accuracy: number | null;       // percentage, null for non-live
  stats: SessionStats | null;    // timing grade breakdown
}
```

**SpacedRepCard Fields:**
```typescript
interface SpacedRepCard {
  patternId: string;
  easeFactor: number;            // SM-2 algorithm
  intervalDays: number;
  repetitions: number;
  lastReviewedAt: number | null;
  nextReviewAt: number | null;
  lastAccuracy: number | null;
}
```

**Key Functions:**
- `addSession()` - creates new session with UUID, prepends to array
- `updateCard()` - computes next review using SM-2, saves to `cards` object
- `getLastLiveSessionForPattern()` - skips index 0 (current), finds most recent live session
- `getDuePatterns()` - returns patterns due + never-practiced patterns
- Sessions stored most-recent-first (prepended)

---

### 7. **GradeToast.tsx**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/live/GradeToast.tsx`

**Functionality:**
- Displays last 4 most recent tap grades as animated toasts
- Each toast shows: Grade label (capitalized) + timing offset in smaller text
- Toast format: `"Perfect +15ms"` or `"Great"` for miss
- Fade-in animation (20ms), hold (560ms), fade-out (20ms total 600ms)

**Data Source:**
```typescript
lastTapGrade: TimingGrade | null     // 'perfect' | 'great' | 'good' | 'early' | 'late' | 'miss'
lastTapOffset: number                 // seconds, converted to ms
```

**Styling:**
- Uses `GRADE_TEXT_COLORS` from types (green/lime/yellow/orange/red)
- Custom CSS animation: translateY + scale + opacity

---

### 8. **TimingIndicator.tsx**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/live/TimingIndicator.tsx`

**Purpose:** Per-track timing visualization

**Layout:**
- Header: "Early" ← → "Late" labels
- One row per track (filtered by single-track mode if active)
- Each row: instrument label + horizontal line with centered timeline + offset indicator

**Track Timing Row Display:**
- If no tap for track: gray baseline with center line
- If tapped:
  - Green dot if abs offset < 15ms
  - Lime if < 30ms
  - Yellow if < 50ms
  - Orange if >= 50ms
  - Dot positioned based on offset (-100ms to +100ms range, clamped)
  - Right side shows offset in ms (tabular nums)

**Data Source:**
```typescript
perTrackOffset: Record<InstrumentId, { offset: number; grade: TimingGrade }>
```

---

### 9. **Supporting Types & Constants**
**Location:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/live-practice/types.ts`

**SessionStats Structure:**
```typescript
interface SessionStats {
  totalExpected: number;
  totalHits: number;
  totalMisses: number;
  perfectCount: number;
  greatCount: number;
  goodCount: number;
  earlyLateCount: number;      // 'early' or 'late' timing
  averageOffset: number;        // seconds
  currentStreak: number;
  bestStreak: number;
  barHistory: BarAccuracy[];
}

interface BarAccuracy {
  accuracy: number;             // percentage
  hits: number;
  total: number;
}
```

**Timing Thresholds:**
```typescript
PERFECT: 0.015 (15ms)
GREAT:   0.030 (30ms)
GOOD:    0.050 (50ms)
MAX_WINDOW: 0.100 (100ms)
```

**Grade Colors:**
- perfect → green-400
- great → lime-400
- good → yellow-400
- early/late → orange-400
- miss → red-500

---

### 10. **Related Components for Context**

**BarHistoryStrip.tsx** - Shows last 12 bars as colored blocks (80%+ green down to red)

**StreakDisplay.tsx** - Shows current streak during active session
- <3: hidden
- 3-9: "Streak" (green, lg text)
- 10-19: "On Fire" (yellow, xl text)
- 20+: "Unstoppable" (orange, 2xl text with glow)

**TimingBreakdownBar.tsx** - Horizontal stacked bar showing timing distribution with percentages

---

## Key Integration Points for Your Features

Based on this structure, here's what you need to know for implementing your features:

1. **Friendly Feedback Messages**: Hook into `lastTapGrade` + `perTrackOffset` to generate contextual messages
2. **Focused Drill Mode Timer**: Would need new mode in `useLivePracticeStore` + new ModeSelector option
3. **Tempo Floor Analysis**: 
   - Access `stats.barHistory` for bar-by-bar accuracy
   - Detect accuracy drop-off pattern (tempo ceiling)
   - Store `bpmFloor` alongside `bpmEnd` in session stats
   - Display in `PatternProgressList` or new progress component

All components follow a consistent pattern:
- Use zustand stores for state management
- Listen to `useLivePracticeStore` for real-time updates during sessions
- Pull from `usePracticeHistoryStore` for historical analysis
- Tailwind for styling with dark theme (bg-[#1a1d27])
- Responsive grid layouts for different viewport sizes

Design a detailed implementation plan for adding 5 features to a drum practice web app (Next.js + Zustand + Web Audio API). Here's the full context:

## Current Architecture
- **Scheduler** (`src/lib/audio/Scheduler.ts`): Lookahead audio scheduler with step/bar callbacks. Has `addStepListener()`, `onBarComplete`, `setBpm()`. Steps fire at 8th/16th/triplet subdivisions.
- **AudioEngine** (`src/lib/audio/AudioEngine.ts`): Singleton with `masterGain → compressor → destination`. Has `setMasterVolume()` but it's NOT wired to the settings store.
- **DrumSynth** (`src/lib/audio/DrumSynth.ts`): `playInstrument(instrumentId, time, velocity, volume)` synthesizes all drum sounds via oscillators/noise.
- **useLivePracticeStore** (`src/lib/store/useLivePracticeStore.ts`): Manages live session state — stats (SessionStats), tap recording, bar history, streaks. Has `startSession()`, `endSession()`, `recordTap()`, `recordMiss()`, `recordBarEnd()`.
- **useTransportStore** (`src/lib/store/useTransportStore.ts`): Transport + tempo ramp. `play()` starts scheduler with `onStep` callback that plays instruments. Tempo ramp logic in `onBarComplete` callback.
- **useSettingsStore** (`src/lib/store/useSettingsStore.ts`): Persisted store with `masterVolume`, `lastPatternId`, `lastBpm`. `masterVolume` exists but is NOT connected to AudioEngine.
- **usePracticeHistoryStore** (`src/lib/store/usePracticeHistoryStore.ts`): Persists `PracticeSession[]` and `SpacedRepCard` records. Sessions have `mode: 'loop' | 'tempo-ramp' | 'live'`, `bpm`, `bpmStart?`, `bpmEnd?`, `accuracy`, `stats`.
- **TapMatcher** (`src/lib/live-practice/TapMatcher.ts`): Matches user taps to expected beats. Thresholds: perfect ≤15ms, great ≤30ms, good ≤50ms, max ≤100ms.
- **Live page** (`src/app/live/page.tsx`): Orchestrates live practice. Has play/stop, TapMatcher ref, sweep interval, bar recording. Two sound trigger points: `useLiveKeyboardHandler.ts` line 34 and `TapPad.tsx` line 45 — both call `playInstrument()` immediately on user input.
- **LiveResultsModal**: Shows accuracy, delta from previous, timing breakdown, bar history trend, streak, avg timing, next review date.
- **LiveStatsPanel**: Real-time 2x2 grid (accuracy, streak, avg timing, last grade) + grade breakdown.
- **BarAccuracy**: `{ accuracy: number, hits: number, total: number }` — tracked per bar in `barHistory`.

## Features to Implement

### 1. Sparse Metronome Modes
Currently there is NO dedicated metronome click in the app — the pattern auto-plays all instruments via `useTransportStore.play()`. We need:
- A metronome click sound (simple oscillator-based click, higher pitch on downbeat)
- Click modes: `every-beat`, `2-and-4`, `one-per-bar`
- The metronome should be separate from the pattern playback — in live mode the pattern plays AND the metronome clicks
- UI: Add a metronome mode selector to the live practice page controls

### 2. Mute Drum Sounds Toggle (Live Mode)
Allow users to toggle off the drum sounds that play when they tap keys/pads during live practice, so they only hear the metronome click. This forces internal rhythm.
- Add `muteDrumSounds: boolean` to the live practice settings
- Guard the `playInstrument()` calls in `useLiveKeyboardHandler.ts` and `TapPad.tsx`
- UI: Toggle switch in live practice controls
- Persisted in settings store

### 3. Friendly Feedback Messages
Replace/supplement the clinical timing data with human-readable coaching messages in the results modal. Analyze timing patterns and generate insights like:
- "You're consistently late on beat 3" (if avg offset for a specific beat position is consistently late)
- "Rushing during the second half of each bar" (if early offsets cluster in later steps)
- "Your hi-hat timing is the most inconsistent" (if one instrument has higher variance)
- "Clean at this tempo - ready to move up 5 BPM" (if accuracy ≥ 90%)
- "Try dropping to X BPM for cleaner practice" (if accuracy < 60%)

This needs per-step and per-instrument tracking that doesn't currently exist in barHistory. We may need to accumulate more data during the session.

### 4. Focused Drill Mode
A timed, simplified practice mode: pick one groove, set a timer (e.g. 2 or 5 minutes), no fills, just groove. Auto-stops when timer expires.
- Add a timer option to the live practice page
- Countdown display during practice
- Auto-stop when timer reaches zero
- Session records the drill duration

### 5. Tempo Floor Finder
After a tempo ramp session, analyze the bar-by-bar accuracy data to find the BPM where accuracy drops below a threshold, and recommend a practice tempo.
- Need to store per-bar BPM alongside accuracy in tempo ramp + live sessions
- Analysis function: find the "cliff" BPM where accuracy drops significantly
- Show the recommended practice BPM in the results modal
- Store `tempoFloor` in the session data

## Design Constraints
- Use existing patterns: Zustand stores with persist middleware, Tailwind CSS dark theme (bg-[#1a1d27]), Web Audio API oscillators
- Keep the metronome click implementation simple (sine wave click, not a sampled sound)
- The friendly feedback should be generated from session data, not require ML
- Changes should be backward compatible with existing stored sessions

Please provide a detailed implementation plan with specific files to create/modify, function signatures, data structures, and UI component specs. Consider the order of implementation (dependencies between features) and any shared infrastructure.

2. Group consecutive bars by BPM

5. Return `{ tempoFloor, recommendedBpm: floor - 5, floorAccuracy }`

message.content: is it better to not play beat sounds and just metronome sounds from live?

content.text:
Depends on what you're practicing:

**Metronome only (mute pattern playback)** — Forces you to internalize the groove. You have to *know* where every hit goes without the reference track guiding you. This is harder and builds real independence. Best for patterns you already know the shape of.

**Pattern + metronome** — Gives you the reference to play along with. Good when learning a new pattern or when you want to check your accuracy against the "answer." But it can mask timing issues because your brain latches onto the pattern audio as a cue instead of your internal clock.

**Metronome only + tap sounds off** — Maximum suffering. You hear nothing but the click. Your hands move, no audio confirms you hit right. This is basically how acoustic practice with a click works. Forces the deepest internalization.

Right now the app only lets you mute your *tap* sounds — the pattern auto-play always runs. Want me to add a toggle to mute the pattern playback too? That way you'd have three independent controls:

- **Metronome**: Off / All Beats / 2&4 / 1/Bar
- **Pattern playback**: On / Off  
- **Tap sounds**: On / Off

This gives you every combination — from full hand-holding (pattern + taps + click) down to just-the-click mode.

Fair enough. The three controls are already there if you want to experiment — metronome mode, tap sounds toggle, and the existing track mute buttons on the sequencer. Play around with the combinations and see what exposes your timing gaps the most.

1→# Changelog
     2→
     3→All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
     4→
     5→## [0.6.0] - 2026-02-27
     6→
     7→### Added
     8→- **Floating Grade Toast** — animated label ("Perfect!", "Great +12ms", etc.) floats up and fades after each tap during live practice
     9→- **Timing Deviation Indicator** — horizontal bar showing how early/late each tap is, with color-coded dot (green center → orange edges, ±100ms scale)
    10→- **Streak Combo Display** — combo counter appears at 3+ streak with escalating visual tiers:
    11→  - 3–9: green glow ("Streak")
    12→  - 10–19: yellow pulse ("On Fire")
    13→  - 20+: orange pulsing glow ("Unstoppable")
    14→  - "Streak Lost" flash on break
    15→- **Bar History Strip** — rolling strip of per-bar accuracy blocks below the beat grid, showing last 12 bars color-coded by accuracy
    16→- **Timing Distribution Bar** — stacked colored bar showing percentage breakdown of perfect/great/good/off/miss grades (shown in results modal and progress page)
    17→- **Session Comparison** — results modal now shows accuracy delta vs previous session ("↑12% from last session" or "↓5%")
    18→- **Bar-by-Bar Trend** — mini bar chart in results modal showing accuracy progression across bars within a session
    19→- **Avg Accuracy** tile added to progress dashboard overall stats row
    20→- **Trend Arrows** in progress page per-pattern session list showing accuracy change between sessions
    21→
    22→### Changed
    23→- Live practice store tracks `lastTapOffset`, `streakBroken`, and per-bar hit/total counters
    24→- `SessionStats` now includes `barHistory` for post-session analysis
    25→- Results modal redesigned with timing distribution bar, previous session comparison, and bar trend chart
    26→- Progress page pattern details now show timing breakdown bars per session
    27→- Overall stats row expanded from 4 to 5 tiles (added avg accuracy)
    28→
    29→## [0.5.0] - 2026-02-19
    30→
    31→### Added
    32→- **Practice History & Stats Tracking** — all practice sessions persisted to localStorage
    33→  - Every live session records: pattern, accuracy, BPM, duration, timing stats
    34→  - Loop/tempo-ramp sessions tracked with duration (accuracy only for live mode)
    35→  - Sessions survive page refresh — up to 2,000 sessions stored
    36→- **SM-2 Spaced Repetition** — Anki-style algorithm suggests which patterns to review next
    37→  - Accuracy-to-quality mapping: 95%+ = perfect recall, down to <30% = complete failure
    38→  - Interval progression: 1 day → 6 days → interval × ease factor (capped at 365 days)
    39→  - Ease factor adjusts based on performance (min 1.3, starts at 2.5)
    40→  - Mastery levels: New → Learning → Familiar → Mastered (based on successful repetitions)
    41→- **Progress Dashboard** (`/progress`) — comprehensive practice analytics page
    42→  - Overall stats row: total practice time, session count, patterns practiced, daily streak
    43→  - Due for Review section: horizontal scroll of patterns needing practice, sorted by overdue time
    44→  - Practice Calendar: 12-week GitHub-style heat map showing daily practice intensity
    45→  - Pattern Progress List: per-pattern accordion with accuracy sparklines, best scores, session history
    46→- **Due for Review Banner** on home page — shows count of patterns due with link to progress page
    47→- **Post-session feedback** — "Next review in X days" shown in live results modal after each session
    48→- Header navigation updated with "Progress" link
    49→
    50→### Changed
    51→- Live practice page now saves sessions and updates spaced repetition cards on stop
    52→- Practice page now saves loop/tempo-ramp sessions on stop (guard: minimum 5 seconds)
    53→- LiveResultsModal shows next review timing from updated SM-2 card
    54→
    55→## [0.4.0] - 2026-02-19
    56→
    57→### Added
    58→- **Piano Sight Reading Practice** (`/sight-reading`) — learn to read music notation with a virtual piano
    59→  - Three practice modes: Note Drill (identify single notes), Interval Training (play two-note intervals), Phrase Reading (play short melodies)
    60→  - SVG music staff with treble clef, note heads, sharps, ledger lines
    61→  - On-screen 2-octave piano keyboard (C3-B4) with click/touch support
    62→  - Computer keyboard mapping: Z-M row for C3-B3, Q-U row for C4-B4 (standard DAW layout)

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [0.6.0] - 2026-02-27

### Added
- **Floating Grade Toast** — animated label ("Perfect!", "Great +12ms", etc.) floats up and fades after each tap during live practice
- **Timing Deviation Indicator** — horizontal bar showing how early/late each tap is, with color-coded dot (green center → orange edges, ±100ms scale)
- **Streak Combo Display** — combo counter appears at 3+ streak with escalating visual tiers:
  - 3–9: green glow ("Streak")
  - 10–19: yellow pulse ("On Fire")
  - 20+: orange pulsing glow ("Unstoppable")
  - "Streak Lost" flash on break
- **Bar History Strip** — rolling strip of per-bar accuracy blocks below the beat grid, showing last 12 bars color-coded by accuracy
- **Timing Distribution Bar** — stacked colored bar showing percentage breakdown of perfect/great/good/off/miss grades (shown in results modal and progress page)
- **Session Comparison** — results modal now shows accuracy delta vs previous session ("↑12% from last session" or "↓5%")
- **Bar-by-Bar Trend** — mini bar chart in results modal showing accuracy progression across bars within a session
- **Avg Accuracy** tile added to progress dashboard overall stats row
- **Trend Arrows** in progress page per-pattern session list showing accuracy change between sessions

### Changed
- Live practice store tracks `lastTapOffset`, `streakBroken`, and per-bar hit/total counters
- `SessionStats` now includes `barHistory` for post-session analysis
- Results modal redesigned with timing distribution bar, previous session comparison, and bar trend chart
- Progress page pattern details now show timing breakdown bars per session
- Overall stats row expanded from 4 to 5 tiles (added avg accuracy)

## [0.5.0] - 2026-02-19

### Added
- **Practice History & Stats Tracking** — all practice sessions persisted to localStorage
  - Every live session records: pattern, accuracy, BPM, duration, timing stats
  - Loop/tempo-ramp sessions tracked with duration (accuracy only for live mode)
  - Sessions survive page refresh — up to 2,000 sessions stored
- **SM-2 Spaced Repetition** — Anki-style algorithm suggests which patterns to review next
  - Accuracy-to-quality mapping: 95%+ = perfect recall, down to <30% = complete failure
  - Interval progression: 1 day → 6 days → interval × ease factor (capped at 365 days)
  - Ease factor adjusts based on performance (min 1.3, starts at 2.5)
  - Mastery levels: New → Learning → Familiar → Mastered (based on successful repetitions)
- **Progress Dashboard** (`/progress`) — comprehensive practice analytics page
  - Overall stats row: total practice time, session count, patterns practiced, daily streak
  - Due for Review section: horizontal scroll of patterns needing practice, sorted by overdue time
  - Practice Calendar: 12-week GitHub-style heat map showing daily practice intensity
  - Pattern Progress List: per-pattern accordion with accuracy sparklines, best scores, session history
- **Due for Review Banner** on home page — shows count of patterns due with link to progress page
- **Post-session feedback** — "Next review in X days" shown in live results modal after each session
- Header navigation updated with "Progress" link

### Changed
- Live practice page now saves sessions and updates spaced repetition cards on stop
- Practice page now saves loop/tempo-ramp sessions on stop (guard: minimum 5 seconds)
- LiveResultsModal shows next review timing from updated SM-2 card

## [0.4.0] - 2026-02-19

### Added
- **Piano Sight Reading Practice** (`/sight-reading`) — learn to read music notation with a virtual piano
  - Three practice modes: Note Drill (identify single notes), Interval Training (play two-note intervals), Phrase Reading (play short melodies)
  - SVG music staff with treble clef, note heads, sharps, ledger lines
  - On-screen 2-octave piano keyboard (C3-B4) with click/touch support
  - Computer keyboard mapping: Z-M row for C3-B3, Q-U row for C4-B4 (standard DAW layout)
  - Three difficulty levels: Beginner (natural notes, 1 octave), Intermediate (all notes, 2 octaves), Advanced (wider intervals, longer phrases)
  - Real-time stats: accuracy %, streak, best streak, average response time
  - Piano tone synthesis using layered sine oscillators (fundamental + 2 harmonics) via Web Audio API
  - Interval name display for educational feedback (e.g., "Major 3rd", "Perfect 5th")
  - Auto-advance to next challenge after completion
- Header navigation updated with "Sight Read" link

## [0.3.0] - 2026-02-18

### Added
- **21 new drum patterns** across 3 new genres + expanded existing categories:
  - Jazz (4): Jazz Ride Pattern, Jazz Brushes, Jazz Waltz, Bebop Comping
  - Electronic (5): House Beat, Techno, Trap Beat, Drum & Bass, Lo-Fi Hip Hop
  - Polyrhythm (6): 3 over 2, 4 over 3, 3 over 4, 5 over 4, 6 over 4 (Hemiola), Polyrhythmic Rock
  - Rock (4 new): Half-Time Rock, Rock Ballad, Punk Rock, Tom Groove
  - Funk (3 new): JB Funk, Ghost Note Funk, Linear Funk
  - Latin (3 new): Samba, Cascara, Cha-Cha
- **Playback auto-stop** — music stops automatically when navigating between pages or switching browser tabs
- Total pattern count: 12 → 33

### Changed
- Pattern category type expanded to include `jazz`, `electronic`, and `polyrhythm`
- Category filter UI updated with new genre colors (amber for jazz, blue for electronic, pink for polyrhythm)

## [0.2.0] - 2026-02-18

### Added
- **Live Practice mode** (`/live`) — tap along to patterns and get real-time timing accuracy feedback
  - TapMatcher algorithm compares user taps against scheduled beats using `audioContext` timestamps for sub-millisecond precision
  - Timing grades: Perfect (<15ms), Great (<30ms), Good (<50ms), Early/Late (>50ms), Miss
  - Color-coded accuracy overlays on beat grid cells (green/lime/yellow/orange/red)
  - On-screen tap pads with touch support for mobile
  - Real-time stats panel: accuracy %, streak counter, average timing offset, grade breakdown
  - Results modal with session summary on stop
  - Full Kit mode (tap all instruments) and Single Track mode (focus on one)
  - Keyboard mappings: D=kick, F=snare, J=hi-hat, K=open hi-hat, S/A/L=toms, G=crash, H=ride
- Step listener system on Scheduler for external subscribers
- Comprehensive project README with architecture docs, pattern library listing, keyboard shortcuts, and file structure

### Changed
- BeatCell, TrackRow, and BeatGrid components now accept optional `accuracyGrade` / `stepAccuracies` props for live practice overlay
- Scheduler instance is now exported from `useTransportStore` for external access
- Header navigation updated with Live tab

## [0.1.0] - 2026-02-18

### Added
- Initial release
- **Pattern Library** — 12 built-in drum patterns across 5 categories:
  - Rock: Basic Rock Beat, Rock Beat (16ths), Four on the Floor, Basic Shuffle
  - Funk: Basic Funk, Syncopated Funk
  - Latin: Bossa Nova
  - World: 6/8 Feel, Afro 6/8
  - Rudiments: Single Paradiddle, Single Stroke Roll, Double Stroke Roll
- **Visual Beat Grid** — interactive sequencer with click-to-toggle steps, color-coded by instrument
- **Web Audio API drum synthesis** — kick, snare, hi-hat (open/closed), 3 toms, crash, ride
  - All sounds generated programmatically, no audio files
  - Shared pre-generated noise buffer for efficiency
- **Lookahead scheduler** — 25ms setTimeout interval with 100ms schedule-ahead window for precise timing
- **BPM control** — slider (40–240), +/- buttons, tap tempo
- **Per-instrument volume** sliders and mute toggles
- **Swing control** (0–100%)
- **Practice modes** — Loop and Tempo Ramp (gradual BPM increase over N bars)
- **Session stats** — elapsed time, bars played, current BPM
- **Keyboard shortcuts** — Space (play/pause), Escape (stop), arrow keys (BPM +/-1, Shift for +/-10)
- **Sticking labels** (R/L) for rudiment patterns
- **Dark theme** UI with responsive layout
- **localStorage persistence** for user settings (master volume, last pattern)
- Zustand state management (transport, pattern, practice, settings stores)

## [0.7.0] - 2026-02-27

### Added
- **Metronome Click** — dedicated sine-wave metronome independent of pattern playback
  - Four modes: Off, All Beats (accent on 1), 2 & 4 only, 1 per Bar
  - Adjustable volume slider
  - Works with all subdivisions (8th, 16th, triplet)
- **Mute Pattern Playback** — toggle to silence the reference pattern, hear only metronome + your taps
- **Mute Tap Sounds** — toggle to silence your own drum hits, forcing internalization of the rhythm
- **Drill Timer** — timed practice mode with preset durations (1, 2, 5, 10 minutes)
  - Countdown display next to play button, pulses red in last 10 seconds
  - Auto-stops session when timer expires
- **Tempo Floor Finder** — analyzes bar-by-bar accuracy after a session to detect the BPM where timing breaks down
  - Groups bars by BPM, finds accuracy cliff (below 70% or 80%)
  - Shows recommended practice tempo (5 BPM below the floor) in results modal
- **Coaching Feedback** — human-readable timing analysis in results modal (up to 3 messages)
  - Per-beat bias: "You're consistently late on beat 3" or "Rushing beat 1"
  - Per-instrument variance: "Your hi-hat timing is the most inconsistent"
  - Bar-half analysis: "Rushing during the second half of each bar"
  - Tempo suggestions: "Clean at 100 BPM — ready to move up 5" or "Try dropping to 85 BPM"

### Changed
- `BarAccuracy` now tracks BPM per bar for tempo floor analysis
- `SessionStats` includes `detailedTaps` array for per-step/per-instrument timing analysis (stripped from localStorage to save space)
- `PracticeSession` extended with optional `drillDurationMs` and `tempoFloor` fields
- Settings store persists metronome mode, metronome volume, mute preferences
- Live practice store tracks drill timer state and bar index for detailed tap recording

## Comprehensive App Structure Analysis

Based on my exploration of your codebase, here's a detailed breakdown of the current app structure and how to restructure it to separate sight reading from drum practice:

## CURRENT APP STRUCTURE

### Route Architecture (Next.js App Router)
```
src/app/
├── layout.tsx                 (Root layout - shared for all routes)
├── globals.css               (Global styles)
├── page.tsx                  (Home - Pattern Library)
├── practice/

├── sight-reading/

└── progress/
    └── page.tsx             (Progress Dashboard)
```

### Navigation (Header)
The Header at `/src/components/Header.tsx` manages all top-level navigation with these routes:
- `/` → "Patterns" (home page)
- `/practice` → "Practice" (drum pattern practice)
- `/live` → "Live" (real-time tapping practice)
- `/sight-reading` → "Sight Read" (piano sight reading)
- `/progress` → "Progress" (analytics & history)

**Key Issue**: The header treats sight-reading as equal to drum practice features, but they're fundamentally different domains.

---

## COMPONENT ORGANIZATION

### Sight Reading Components
```
src/components/sight-reading/
├── Staff.tsx                (Musical staff rendering)
├── PianoKeyboard.tsx        (Interactive piano keys)
├── NoteHead.tsx             (SVG note rendering)
├── ModeSelector.tsx         (note-drill, interval, phrase modes)
├── DifficultySelector.tsx   (Difficulty selection)
├── StatsPanel.tsx           (Session stats display)
└── ResultFeedback.tsx       (Feedback on submissions)
```

### Drum Practice Components
```
src/components/
├── practice/
│   ├── PracticeModeSelector.tsx    (loop, tempo-ramp modes)
│   ├── TempoRampConfig.tsx         (BPM ramping settings)
│   └── PracticeStats.tsx           (Practice stats display)
├── live/
│   ├── TapPadPanel.tsx             (Visual tap pads)
│   ├── TapPad.tsx                  (Individual pad)
│   ├── ModeSelector.tsx            (single-track, full-kit modes)
│   ├── TimingIndicator.tsx         (Real-time feedback)
│   ├── StreakDisplay.tsx           (Accuracy streaks)
│   ├── BarHistoryStrip.tsx         (Bar-by-bar history)
│   ├── LiveStatsPanel.tsx          (Session statistics)
│   ├── MetronomeControls.tsx       (Click track control)
│   ├── DrillTimerControls.tsx      (Timer for drill sessions)
│   ├── GradeToast.tsx              (Feedback toast)
│   └── LiveResultsModal.tsx        (Results modal)
├── sequencer/
│   └── BeatGrid.tsx                (16-step drum grid)
├── controls/                        (Shared controls)
├── home/
│   └── DueForReviewBanner.tsx      (SM-2 spaced repetition banner)
└── progress/                        (Progress tracking components)
```

---

## STATE MANAGEMENT (Zustand Stores)

### Drum Practice Stores
- **`usePatternStore.ts`** - Current pattern, pattern library, modifications
- **`useTransportStore.ts`** - Playback state (play/stop/pause), BPM, transport scheduling
- **`usePracticeStore.ts`** - Practice mode (loop/tempo-ramp), tempo ramp config
- **`useLivePracticeStore.ts`** - Live mode state, tap accuracy, statistics
- **`usePracticeHistoryStore.ts`** - Session history, spaced repetition tracking

### Sight Reading Stores
- **`useSightReadingStore.ts`** - Target notes, current note, challenge state, results, statistics

### Shared Stores
- **`useSettingsStore.ts`** - Global settings

---

## LIBRARY ORGANIZATION

### Patterns Library (`src/lib/patterns/`)
```
├── index.ts              (Exports allPatterns, categories, helper functions)
├── types.ts              (DrumPattern, Track, Step, PatternCategory types)
├── utils.ts              (Pattern utilities)
├── rock.ts               (Rock patterns)
├── funk.ts               (Funk patterns)
├── latin.ts              (Latin patterns)
├── rudiments.ts          (Rudiment patterns)
├── jazz.ts               (Jazz patterns)
├── electronic.ts         (Electronic patterns)
└── polyrhythms.ts        (Polyrhythm patterns)
```

**Key File**: `/src/lib/patterns/types.ts` defines core types:
- `DrumPattern` - Complete pattern definition
- `PatternCategory` - 'rock' | 'funk' | 'latin' | 'world' | 'rudiment' | 'jazz' | 'electronic' | 'polyrhythm'
- `Track`, `Step`, `InstrumentId` - Drum kit structure

### Sight Reading Library (`src/lib/sight-reading/`)
```
├── generator.ts          (Exercise generation logic)
└── notes.ts              (Piano note definitions and mapping)
```

### Other Libraries
- `src/lib/audio/` - AudioEngine, PianoSynth, drum synthesizer
- `src/lib/live-practice/` - TapMatcher, timing analysis
- `src/lib/hooks/` - useKeyboardShortcuts, usePianoKeyboard, etc.
- `src/lib/spaced-repetition/` - SM-2 algorithm implementation

---

## PROPOSED RESTRUCTURING STRATEGY

To separate sight reading from drum practice as distinct sections, you have several options:

### **Option 1: Group Routes Under Parent Directories (Recommended)**
```
src/app/
├── layout.tsx
├── page.tsx                          (Home/Landing)
├── drum-practice/
│   ├── layout.tsx                   (Drum-specific layout, optional Header variant)
│   ├── patterns/
│   │   └── page.tsx                 (Pattern Library)
│   ├── practice/
│   │   └── page.tsx                 (Practice Mode)
│   └── live/
│       └── page.tsx                 (Live Practice)
├── sight-reading/
│   ├── layout.tsx                   (Sight-reading layout)
│   └── page.tsx                     (Sight Reading)
└── progress/
    └── page.tsx                     (Progress - spans both domains)
```

**Advantages**:
- Clear organizational hierarchy
- Easy to add domain-specific layouts
- Can have separate Header variants if needed
- Natural for navigation restructuring
- Scales well for future expansions

### **Option 2: Modified Navigation Header**
Keep the current route structure but restructure the header navigation into grouped sections:

```typescript
const nav = [
  {
    group: 'Drum Practice',
    items: [
      { href: '/', label: 'Patterns' },
      { href: '/practice', label: 'Practice' },
      { href: '/live', label: 'Live' },
    ]
  },
  {
    group: 'Music Training',
    items: [
      { href: '/sight-reading', label: 'Sight Reading' },
    ]
  },
  {
    group: 'Analytics',
    items: [
      { href: '/progress', label: 'Progress' },
    ]
  },
];
```

**Advantages**:
- Minimal file restructuring
- Quick implementation
- Clear visual separation in UI
- Good if routes are fine as-is

### **Option 3: Hybrid Approach**
Keep routes as-is but create separate domain layouts:
```
src/app/
├── layout.tsx                        (Root)
├── (drum-practice)/                  (Route group - no URL segment)
│   ├── layout.tsx
│   ├── page.tsx
│   ├── practice/page.tsx
│   └── live/page.tsx
├── (sight-reading)/                  (Route group)
│   ├── layout.tsx
│   └── sight-reading/page.tsx
└── progress/page.tsx
```

**Advantages**:
- No URL changes
- Separate layouts per domain
- Uses Next.js route groups feature
- Excellent DX

---

## KEY INSIGHTS FOR RESTRUCTURING

```
  <Staff /> (SVG staff with notes)
  <ResultFeedback /> (correct/wrong indicator)
  <PianoKeyboard /> (interactive keys)
  <StatsPanel /> (session metrics)
  <Keyboard Help Box>
```

---

### 2. Audio System

**PianoSynth:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/audio/PianoSynth.ts`

**`playPianoNote(noteIndex, velocity=0.6)`:**
- Uses **layered sine oscillators** to create realistic piano timbre:
  - Fundamental frequency (1x) at full amplitude
  - 2nd harmonic at 0.4x amplitude
  - 3rd harmonic at 0.15x amplitude
- **Envelope**: 1.5-second exponential decay from velocity to 0.001
- Each harmonic shares a gain envelope for cohesive sound
- Uses Web Audio API oscillators connected to shared gain node

**`playErrorBuzz()`:**
- Generates white noise burst (12ms duration)
- Bandpass filter at 800Hz with Q=2 (creates buzzing tone)
- Gain: 0.15 initial, exponential decay to 0.001

**AudioEngine:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/audio/AudioEngine.ts`

**Features:**
- Singleton pattern with lazy initialization
- **Routing Chain**: Oscillators → Compressor (threshold -12dB, ratio 4) → Destination
- **Pre-generated Noise Buffer**: 2-second white noise buffer for error buzzes
- **Compression**: Prevents audio clipping with dynamics compressor
- **Auto-Resume**: Handles suspended audio contexts (browser autoplay policies)
- Master volume control

---

### 3. Note System & Generation

**Notes Definitions:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/sight-reading/notes.ts`

**NoteInfo Interface:**
```typescript
{
  index: 0-23,           // position in 24-note range
  name: "C3"-"B4",       // display name
  letter: "C"-"G",       // diatonic note
  octave: 3 or 4,
  frequency: Hz,         // A440 equal temperament
  isSharp: boolean,
  midiNumber: 48-71,
  staffSlot: number,     // diatonic steps from C4
  keyboardKey: string    // z-m (octave 3), q-u (octave 4)
}
```

**24 Notes Defined:**
- **Octave 3 (C3-B3)**: Z-row (white keys), S/D/G/H/J (black keys)
- **Octave 4 (C4-B4)**: Q-row (white keys), 2/3/5/6/7 (black keys)
- Frequency calculated via A440 equal temperament: `440 * 2^((midi - 69) / 12)`
- staffSlot mapping: diatonic position relative to middle C (C4=0)

**Difficulty Filters:**
- **Beginner**: Natural notes only, octave 4 (C4-B4, 7 notes)
- **Intermediate**: All 24 notes (2 octaves with all sharps)
- **Advanced**: All 24 notes (same as intermediate)

**Interval Names:** Maps semitone intervals (0-12) to musical names (Unison, Major 3rd, Perfect 5th, etc.)

---

### 4. Challenge Generator

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/sight-reading/generator.ts`

**Three Challenge Modes:**

**1. Note Drill** - `generateNoteDrill()`
- Returns single note as array `[noteIndex]`
- Avoids repeating the same note twice in a row
- Uses all notes for the selected difficulty

**2. Interval Mode** - `generateInterval()`
- Generates 2-note interval challenge
- Beginner: up to perfect 5th (7 semitones max)
- Intermediate/Advanced: up to octave (12 semitones max)
- Always returns lower note first: `[lower, upper]`

**3. Phrase Mode** - `generatePhrase()`
- Generates melodic sequence of multiple notes
- **Length by Difficulty:**
  - Beginner: 4 notes
  - Intermediate: 4-6 notes
  - Advanced: 6-8 notes
- **Interval Constraints (max step between consecutive notes):**
  - Beginner: 4 semitones (major 3rd max)
  - Intermediate: 7 semitones (perfect 5th max)
  - Advanced: 12 semitones (full octave)
- Uses weighted random selection to create natural-sounding melodies

---

### 5. Music Staff Rendering

**Staff Component:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/Staff.tsx`

**SVG Dimensions:**
- Canvas: 600x260px
- Staff lines: 5 horizontal lines, 14px apart
- Top margin: 60px
- Note spacing: 70px horizontal
- Left margin: 80px (for treble clef)

**Treble Clef:**
- Rendered as Unicode musical symbol `\u{1D11E}` at 72px font
- Positioned at x=35, y=STAFF_LINES[4]+10

**Staff Position Mapping:**
```
Treble clef lines (top to bottom): F5, D5, B4, G4, E4
E4 = bottom line (lowest staff line)
C4 = one space below (ledger line)
```

**Y Position Calculation:**
- Each diatonic step = LINE_SPACING/2 pixels (7px)
- `E4Y - (staffSlot - 2) * 7px`

**Ledger Lines (Extended Staff):**
- Below staff: For notes C4 and below (staffSlot ≤ 0)
  - Rendered at staffSlots 0, -2, -4, -6, etc.
- Above staff: For notes above F5 (staffSlot ≥ 12)
  - Rendered at staffSlots 12, 14, 16, etc.

**Note Coloring:**
- **Gray** (#9ca3af): Unanswered notes
- **Blue** (#60a5fa): Current note being played
- **Green** (#4ade80): Correct answer
- **Red** (#f87171): Wrong answer

---

### 6. Note Head Rendering

**NoteHead Component:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/NoteHead.tsx`

**Visual Elements:**
1. **Sharp Symbol** (♯) - offset 18px left of note head
   - Only rendered for `isSharp=true`
   - Same color as note head
2. **Note Head** - Filled ellipse (7x5px)
   - Rotated -10 degrees for tilted appearance
   - Positioned at (x, y)
3. **Stem** - Vertical line
   - Starts at x+6.5 (right edge of note head)
   - Extends 30px upward
   - 1.5px stroke width

**React Memo Optimization:** Component is memoized to prevent unnecessary re-renders

---

### 7. Piano Keyboard

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/PianoKeyboard.tsx`

**Visual Layout:**
- **White Keys**: 17 keys (C3-B3, C4-B4)
  - Width: 36px, Height: 140px
  - Gray background (#e5e7eb) → Blue (#60a5fa) when active
- **Black Keys**: 10 sharps total (no F# and B# as they don't exist)
  - Width: 22px, Height: 88px
  - Dark gray (#1f2937) → Darker blue (#3b82f6) when active
  - Positioned 50% overlapping the white key to the right

**Key Labels:**
- White keys: Note name at bottom (C3, D3, etc.)
- Keyboard shortcut above note name (z, x, c, etc.)
- Black keys: Keyboard shortcut only

**Input Handling:**
- Both `onMouseDown` and `onTouchStart` events
- Prevents default and stops propagation on black keys
- Active note feedback via color transition (75ms)

**Positioning:**
- White key map: Build dynamic map of white key positions by index
- Black key positioning: `leftWhiteX + WHITE_KEY_WIDTH - BLACK_KEY_WIDTH/2`
- Z-index: White keys (1) below Black keys (2)

---

### 8. Mode & Difficulty Selectors

**ModeSelector:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/ModeSelector.tsx`

Three modes with descriptions:
- **Note Drill**: "Identify single notes"
- **Intervals**: "Play two-note intervals"
- **Phrases**: "Read short melodies"

Clicking mode resets the current session (clears targetNotes, index, results).

**DifficultySelector:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/DifficultySelector.tsx`

Three levels:
- **Beginner**: 7 natural notes (C4-B4 only)
- **Intermediate**: 24 notes (both octaves, all sharps)
- **Advanced**: 24 notes (same as intermediate)

Clicking difficulty also resets the current session.

---

### 9. Statistics Panel

**StatsPanel Component:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/StatsPanel.tsx`

**Real-time Metrics:**
1. **Accuracy %** - (correct / totalAttempts) × 100
2. **Correct Count** - "X/Y correct"
3. **Streak** - Current correct-in-a-row count with best streak shown
4. **Avg Response Time** - Only counts correct responses, running average
5. **Elapsed Time** - MM:SS format, counts from `stats.startTime`

All stats reset when starting a new session.

---

### 10. Result Feedback

**ResultFeedback Component:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sight-reading/ResultFeedback.tsx`

**Feedback Elements:**
1. **Immediate Feedback** (800ms)
   - Green pulsing "Correct!" for right answer
   - Red pulsing "Wrong" for wrong answer
2. **Interval Name** (for interval mode only)
   - Shows after completing a 2-note interval
   - e.g., "Major 3rd", "Perfect 5th"
   - Calculates semitone difference from MIDI numbers
3. **Phrase Summary** (for phrase mode only)
   - Shows "X/Y correct" after completing a phrase
   - No summary for note-drill or interval modes

---

### 11. Keyboard Input Hook

**usePianoKeyboard Hook:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/hooks/usePianoKeyboard.ts`

**Features:**
- Maps keyboard keys to note indices via `KEY_TO_NOTE` lookup
- **Keydown Handler**:
  - Tracks pressed keys in a Set to prevent repeat-fire
  - Ignores input from HTML input/textarea elements
  - Only fires once per physical key press (prevents held-key repeat)
  - Calls `onNotePlay(noteIndex)` on valid note keys
- **Keyup Handler**:
  - Removes key from pressed set
- **Toggle**: `enabled` prop to enable/disable keyboard input
- Proper cleanup: removes event listeners on unmount

**Key Mapping:**
- Lower octave (C3-B3): z, s, x, d, c, v, g, b, h, n, j, m
- Upper octave (C4-B4): q, 2, w, 3, e, r, 5, t, 6, y, 7, u

---

### 12. Store - useSightReadingStore

**File:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/useSightReadingStore.ts`

**State Structure:**
```typescript
{
  // Configuration
  mode: 'note-drill' | 'interval' | 'phrase',
  difficulty: 'beginner' | 'intermediate' | 'advanced',
  
  // Challenge State
  targetNotes: number[],           // note indices to play
  currentNoteIndex: number,        // current position in challenge
  challengeActive: boolean,        // is a challenge in progress
  challengeStartTime: number | null, // timestamp when challenge started
  
  // Results
  results: NoteResult[],           // array of {targetNote, playedNote, correct, responseTimeMs}
  lastResult: 'correct' | 'wrong' | null,
  
  // Session Statistics
  stats: {
    totalAttempts: number,
    correct: number,
    streak: number,               // current correct streak
    bestStreak: number,           // best streak in session
    avgResponseMs: number,        // running average (only correct)
    startTime: number | null,     // session start timestamp
  }
}
```

**Actions:**
1. **`setMode(mode)`** - Changes mode, resets challenge
2. **`setDifficulty(difficulty)`** - Changes difficulty, resets challenge
3. **`startSession()`** - Initializes new session:
   - Calls `generateChallenge(mode, difficulty)`
   - Sets `challengeActive=true`
   - Resets stats with current timestamp
   - Clears results
4. **`nextChallenge()`** - Generates next challenge:
   - Calls `generateChallenge()` passing previous note to avoid immediate repeat
   - Resets indices and lastResult
5. **`submitNote(noteIndex)`** - Processes a note submission:
   - Compares against `targetNotes[currentNoteIndex]`
   - Calculates response time from `challengeStartTime`
   - Updates stats: total, correct count, streak, best streak, avg response
   - Checks if challenge is complete (all notes played)
   - If complete: `challengeActive=false`
   - Auto-resets `challengeStartTime` on next note
6. **`resetSession()`** - Clears all session data and returns to initial state

---

### 13. Navigation Integration

**Header Component:** `/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/Header.tsx`

**Navigation Structure:**
```
Main Logo → Drum Practice (links to /)
├── Patterns (/)
├── Practice (/practice)
├── Live (/live)
├── Sight Read (/sight-reading)  ← Active route
└── Progress (/progress)
```

**Features:**
- Sticky header (top: 0, z-50)
- Current route highlighted with bg-gray-800
- Uses Next.js `usePathname()` for active state
- Backdrop blur effect

---

### 14. Complete File Structure Summary

```
src/
├── app/sight-reading/
│   └── page.tsx                          (Main page component)
├── components/sight-reading/
│   ├── Staff.tsx                         (SVG staff rendering)
│   ├── NoteHead.tsx                      (SVG note head rendering)
│   ├── PianoKeyboard.tsx                 (Interactive piano)
│   ├── ModeSelector.tsx                  (Challenge mode buttons)
│   ├── DifficultySelector.tsx            (Difficulty buttons)
│   ├── StatsPanel.tsx                    (Session statistics)
│   └── ResultFeedback.tsx                (Correct/Wrong feedback)
├── lib/
│   ├── audio/
│   │   ├── PianoSynth.ts                 (Note playback, error buzz)
│   │   └── AudioEngine.ts                (Web Audio API setup)
│   ├── sight-reading/
│   │   ├── notes.ts                      (Note definitions & frequencies)
│   │   └── generator.ts                  (Challenge generators)
│   ├── store/
│   │   └── useSightReadingStore.ts       (Zustand state management)
│   ├── hooks/
│   │   └── usePianoKeyboard.ts           (Keyboard input handler)
│   └── (other stores and hooks)
└── components/
    └── Header.tsx                        (Navigation header)
```

---

### 15. Data Flow Summary

```
User Action (click key/piano)
    ↓
handleNotePlay() in page.tsx
    ↓
playPianoNote() + visual feedback (activeNote state)
    ↓
submitNote() in store → processes answer
    ↓
Updates: results, stats (streak, accuracy, response time), currentNoteIndex
    ↓
If challenge complete: challengeActive=false, triggers auto-advance timer
    ↓
nextChallenge() generates new targetNotes
    ↓
UI re-renders with new challenge
```

All files have been thoroughly analyzed with complete file contents provided above. The sight reading system is comprehensive, with proper separation of concerns: audio engine, note generation, UI components, and state management all working together seamlessly.

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Analysis:
Let me chronologically analyze the conversation:

1. **Initial user message**: User shared their experience practicing drums with the app, noting high timing variance. They shared detailed advice about improving drum practice (internal clock, tension, playing above clean tempo, etc.).

2. **My response**: I explored the codebase to understand the current feedback system. Found that "variant is high" message doesn't exist - the app shows timing grades (Perfect/Great/Good/Early/Late) with ms offsets. I proposed 4 features:
   - Sparse metronome modes (2&4, half-time, one per bar)
   - Focused drill mode (one groove, timed, no fills)
   - Friendlier feedback language
   - Tempo floor finder

3. **User said "yes these all sound good"** and asked me to explain tempo floor finder and whether playing sounds in live mode is good or bad.

4. **My response**: Explained tempo floor finder (analyze tempo ramp data to find BPM where accuracy drops, recommend practice tempo 15-20 below). Explained sound toggle should be a setting, not a decision. Entered plan mode.

5. **Planning phase**: I explored the codebase thoroughly with multiple agents, read all critical files, and designed a comprehensive implementation plan. Created plan at `/Users/chiu.fyi/.claude/plans/twinkly-sauteeing-bunny.md`.

6. **Implementation phase** - I implemented all 5 features plus shared infrastructure:

   **Shared Infrastructure:**
   - Extended `BarAccuracy` with `bpm?: number`
   - Added `DetailedTapRecord` type
   - Extended `SessionStats` with `detailedTaps`
   - Extended `PracticeSession` with `drillDurationMs?` and `tempoFloor?`

   **Feature 1: Sparse Metronome**
   - Created `MetronomeClick.ts` - sine wave click synth
   - Added `MetronomeMode` type
   - Extended `useSettingsStore` with metronome settings
   - Added metronome logic to `useTransportStore` onStep callback
   - Created `MetronomeControls.tsx` component

   **Feature 2: Mute Drum Sounds**
   - Added `muteDrumSounds` to settings store
   - Guarded `playInstrument()` in `useLiveKeyboardHandler.ts` and `TapPad.tsx`
   - Added toggle to MetronomeControls

   **Feature 3: Focused Drill Mode**
   - Extended `useLivePracticeStore` with drill timer state
   - Created `useDrillTimer.ts` hook
   - Created `DrillTimerControls.tsx` with selector and countdown

   **Feature 4: Tempo Floor Finder**
   - Created `tempoFloorAnalyzer.ts`
   - Integrated into `LiveResultsModal.tsx` and session persistence

   **Feature 5: Friendly Feedback**
   - Created `feedbackAnalyzer.ts` with per-step, per-instrument, and bar-half analysis
   - Integrated coaching section into `LiveResultsModal.tsx`

7. **User asked about playing sounds in live mode** - I explained the tradeoffs and proposed adding a pattern playback mute toggle (3 independent controls). User said "there is no yes" - declining the feature.

8. **Wait, re-reading**: User then said "yes" in a separate message - actually approving the pattern playback mute toggle.

9. **I implemented the pattern playback mute toggle**:
   - Added `mutePatternPlayback` to `useSettingsStore`
   - Guarded pattern playback in `useTransportStore` onStep
   - Added "Pattern On/Off" button to `MetronomeControls`
   - Fixed duplicate `require` for useSettingsStore

10. **User asked "did you add to changelog?"** - I read the existing CHANGELOG.md and added v0.7.0 entry.

11. **User's latest request**: "make sight reading as a separate section of the app from drum practice. additionally add more practice modes, like maybe typing in the letter of the key being played or even a mic option to listen to a piano. feel free to also add popular melodies as well as a feature"

12. **I entered plan mode** and launched explore agents to understand the sight reading system and app structure. Read the key files: Header.tsx, sight-reading/page.tsx, useSightReadingStore.ts, generator.ts, notes.ts, layout.tsx.

13. **Planning was interrupted** by the summary request. I was in the middle of plan mode, having completed Phase 1 (exploration) and about to move to Phase 2 (design).

Key errors encountered:
- Duplicate `require('./useSettingsStore')` in useTransportStore.ts after adding pattern playback mute - fixed by removing the duplicate and reusing the existing `settings` variable.
- `detailedTaps` would be persisted to localStorage making it large - fixed by stripping it (`detailedTaps: []`) in the `handleStop` persistence call.

All builds passed cleanly throughout.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user is building a drum practice web app and has been iterating on features. The conversation covered three main phases:
   
   **Phase 1 (Completed)**: User reported high timing variance while practicing and wanted tools to fix it. I proposed and implemented 5 features: sparse metronome modes, mute drum sounds toggle, focused drill mode, tempo floor finder, and friendly coaching feedback messages.
   
   **Phase 2 (Completed)**: User approved adding a pattern playback mute toggle (3 independent audio controls: metronome, pattern playback, tap sounds). Also requested changelog update (added as v0.7.0).
   
   **Phase 3 (In Progress - Planning)**: User requested: "make sight reading as a separate section of the app from drum practice. additionally add more practice modes, like maybe typing in the letter of the key being played or even a mic option to listen to a piano. feel free to also add popular melodies as well as a feature"

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Next.js App Router (route groups, layouts)
   - Zustand state management with persist middleware
   - Web Audio API (oscillator synthesis, AudioContext scheduling)
   - Lookahead audio scheduler (25ms setTimeout, 100ms schedule-ahead)
   - SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm
   - SVG music staff rendering
   - Piano keyboard input mapping (Z-M row = C3-B3, Q-U row = C4-B4)
   - Timing analysis: per-step bias, per-instrument variance, bar-half rushing detection
   - Tempo floor detection: grouping bars by BPM and finding accuracy cliff

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **New files created (v0.7.0 features):**
   
   - `src/lib/audio/MetronomeClick.ts` — Sine-wave metronome click synth
     ```typescript
     export function playMetronomeClick(time: number, isDownbeat: boolean, volume: number): void {
       // 1000Hz downbeat, 800Hz offbeat, 50ms duration
       // oscillator → gain → audioEngine.destination
     }
     ```
   
   - `src/components/live/MetronomeControls.tsx` — Mode selector (Off/All Beats/2&4/1 per Bar), volume slider, pattern mute toggle, tap sounds mute toggle
   
   - `src/components/live/DrillTimerControls.tsx` — Two components: `DrillTimerSelector` (preset buttons: No Timer, 1/2/5/10 min) and `DrillCountdown` (M:SS display, pulses red at <10s)
   
   - `src/lib/hooks/useDrillTimer.ts` — Countdown hook using setInterval at 250ms, calls `onExpire` (handleStop) when timer reaches zero
   
   - `src/lib/live-practice/feedbackAnalyzer.ts` — Generates up to 3 coaching messages
     ```typescript
     export function analyzeFeedback(stats: SessionStats, bpm: number, totalStepsPerBar: number): FeedbackMessage[]
     // Analyzes: per-step timing bias, per-instrument variance, bar-half rushing/dragging, overall tempo suggestions
     ```
   
   - `src/lib/live-practice/tempoFloorAnalyzer.ts` — Finds BPM where accuracy drops
     ```typescript
     export function findTempoFloor(barHistory: BarAccuracy[], accuracyThreshold: number = 70): TempoFloorResult | null
     // Groups consecutive bars by BPM, averages accuracy per group, finds first below threshold
     ```

   **Modified files (v0.7.0 features):**
   
   - `src/lib/live-practice/types.ts` — Added `MetronomeMode`, `DetailedTapRecord`, `BarAccuracy.bpm?`, `SessionStats.detailedTaps`
     ```typescript
     export type MetronomeMode = 'off' | 'every-beat' | '2-and-4' | 'one-per-bar';
     export interface DetailedTapRecord {
       step: number; instrumentId: InstrumentId; offset: number; grade: TimingGrade; barIndex: number;
     }
     ```
   
   - `src/lib/store/useSettingsStore.ts` — Added `metronomeMode`, `metronomeVolume`, `muteDrumSounds`, `mutePatternPlayback` (all persisted)
   
   - `src/lib/store/useLivePracticeStore.ts` — Added drill timer state (`drillDurationMs`, `drillStartedAt`, `drillRemainingMs`), `currentBarIndex`, detailed tap recording in `recordTap()`, BPM parameter to `recordBarEnd(currentBpm?)`
   
   - `src/lib/store/useTransportStore.ts` — Added metronome click logic and pattern playback mute guard in `onStep` callback. Uses lazy `require('./useSettingsStore')` to avoid circular imports.
   
   - `src/lib/store/usePracticeHistoryStore.ts` — Extended `PracticeSession` with `drillDurationMs?` and `tempoFloor?`
   
   - `src/lib/hooks/useLiveKeyboardHandler.ts` — Added `useSettingsStore` import and `muteDrumSounds` guard around `playInstrument()`
   
   - `src/components/live/TapPad.tsx` — Same `muteDrumSounds` guard
   
   - `src/app/live/page.tsx` — Wired all features: MetronomeControls, DrillTimerControls, DrillCountdown, useDrillTimer hook, BPM passed to recordBarEnd, tempoFloor computed and persisted, detailedTaps stripped from localStorage persistence
   
   - `src/components/live/LiveResultsModal.tsx` — Added coaching feedback section and tempo floor card
   
   - `CHANGELOG.md` — Added v0.7.0 entry

   **Files read for Phase 3 planning (sight reading restructure):**
   
   - `src/components/Header.tsx` — Current flat nav: Patterns, Practice, Live, Sight Read, Progress. Logo says "Drum Practice". Needs restructuring for separate sections.
   
   - `src/app/sight-reading/page.tsx` — Full sight reading page with Staff, PianoKeyboard, ModeSelector, DifficultySelector, StatsPanel, ResultFeedback. Uses `useSightReadingStore` and `usePianoKeyboard` hook. Handles note playing, visual feedback, auto-advance.
   
   - `src/lib/store/useSightReadingStore.ts` — Zustand store with modes (note-drill/interval/phrase), difficulties (beginner/intermediate/advanced), challenge state, results, session stats.
   
   - `src/lib/sight-reading/generator.ts` — `generateChallenge()` with three modes: `generateNoteDrill()`, `generateInterval()`, `generatePhrase()`. Exports `SightReadingMode` type.
   
   - `src/lib/sight-reading/notes.ts` — 24 notes (C3-B4), `ALL_NOTES`, `KEY_TO_NOTE`, `getNotesForDifficulty()`, `getIntervalName()`. `Difficulty` type.
   
   - `src/app/layout.tsx` — Root layout with Geist fonts, dark theme, PlaybackGuard component.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **Duplicate `require` in useTransportStore.ts**: After adding `mutePatternPlayback` guard, the metronome section still had its own `require('./useSettingsStore')` and `settings` declaration, causing a duplicate variable. Fixed by removing the duplicate and reusing the `settings` variable from the pattern playback section.
   - **detailedTaps localStorage bloat**: `stats: { ...finalStats }` in `handleStop` would persist the full `detailedTaps` array to localStorage. Fixed by spreading with empty array: `stats: { ...finalStats, detailedTaps: [] }`.
   - **User said "there is no yes"**: I had asked "Want me to add a toggle to mute the pattern playback too?" and misinterpreted user intent. They were declining — they just wanted my opinion, not a feature. I acknowledged and moved on. User then said "yes" in a follow-up message, actually approving it.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Solved circular import issue in useTransportStore by using lazy `require()` for useSettingsStore (matching existing pattern for usePatternStore and usePracticeStore)
   - Solved backward compatibility for stored sessions by making all new fields optional (`bpm?` on BarAccuracy, `detailedTaps` handled with `?? []` fallback, `drillDurationMs?` and `tempoFloor?` on PracticeSession)
   - All builds passed cleanly after each change
